vaults.description: Encrypted YAML files that secret templates can read with vault. Decrypted only when a template calls vault for them, at most once per run.

stores.description: Named S3-compatible buckets. Several repos can share one store.

default.description: Used for any repo that has no entry under repos. Omit it to make unknown repos an error.

repos.description: Keyed by repo id: host/owner/name, from the origin remote.

store.description: Name of a store under stores.

prefix.description: Key prefix for every key of the repo. A template that may use .Host, .Owner and .Repo.

pr.description: Overrides the key layout of the pr type.

types.description: Extra asset types. Wins over .prassets.yaml per type name.

endpoint.description: S3 endpoint host, with no scheme.

public_url.description: Base URL that serves the bucket.

insecure.description: Use http instead of https, for a local MinIO.

access_key.description: Secret template: a literal, or a Go template with env, cmd, vault and file.

secret_key.description: Secret template: a literal, or a Go template with env, cmd, vault and file.

session_token.description: Optional secret template for temporary credentials.

key.description: Key template. Fields: .Host .Owner .Repo .Branch .Slug .File. Functions: lower, slugify. Must reference .File.

usage.description: What the type is for, shown by pra types.

path.description: Path to the encrypted file. ~ is expanded.

format.description: age: the whole file is age-encrypted. sops: a sops-encrypted YAML file with age recipients.

identity.description: age identity file. Default: $PRASSETS_AGE_IDENTITY, then $SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE, then ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt.
